description: Rijnbuurt-Oost (Plan Zuid, BAG 1934), Eemsstraat 6-36 (even side): the house beside the centre-erker house carries its own three-storey canted brick erker against the shared party wall (white-framed three-light glazing over brick stallrisers on storeys 1-3, the two erkers 1.1-1.4 m apart across the wall) on a white slab over a wide ground window, a narrow window axis at the far side over the portiek doors; under the row's flat-roof overhang

overhang.note: the row's flat-roof overhang runs over the erker top

door-left.note: the portiek doors under the narrow axis at the far party wall

match.note: the BAG outline's erker at the end of the front (centre 0.84-0.85: Eemsstraat 30 and 6; Eemsstraat 22 and 14 have the erker in the photo but not in BAG, so the photo decides there)

rhythm.bays: a narrow window axis and a wide erker axis at the party wall
rhythm.symmetry: the erker faces the centre-erker house's across the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: the portiek doors at the far party wall, a wide window under the erker slab
rhythm.roofline: flat roof with a white-fascia overhang over the erker
